messages:
Grace H: heads-up — trial account 'AtlasFoods' (af-209) is stuck on week 1. they can't access the reporting tab due to RBAC. renewal/convert check in 21 days and CSM says exec demo next week.
Miles D: rbacs? is it our console bug or their role setup?
Grace H: they set up org roles but the reports permission isn't showing for admins. likely a permissions sync miss. they tried to add the user but UI errored with '403: insufficient scope'.
Anika V: I can push a per-account admin-elevate flag so we can bypass RBAC for their admin user temporarily. will need audit + auto-revert. estimate 30m.
Omar K: please also propose a short save plan for CS: 1) 60-min enablement workshop with their ops lead + product demo for execs, 2) enable admin-elevate for 48h, 3) provide a 2-week "concierge" onboarding (2 x 1-hr sessions) if they convert in 10 days.
Grace H: agree. also want to capture feedback in a quick 3-question post-workshop survey so product can classify root cause as "RBAC docs", "console bug", or "customer setup".
Anika V: enabling flag now. command: `POST /internal/customers/af-209/flags -d '{"admin_elevate":true, "ttl_hours":48}'` — audit_id=aud-az12. will auto-revert.
CS Ops Bot: [action created] #ticket-9910 assigned to Grace H — "AtlasFoods save: admin-elevate + enablement workshop". Due: 2027-03-15
Miles D: Grace, schedule the workshop. include quick agenda: repro, short-term workaround, migration to proper RBAC, timeline. add the 3-question feedback in the invite doc.
Grace H: scheduled for Thu 2pm CT. invite: their ops lead, our solutions eng (Anika), product PM (Miles), and me. added survey link in the calendar.
Omar K: commercial fallback: add downgrade bullets to ticket in case they pause: - prorated downgrade to Basic for first month - preserve exports for 90 days - 30-day reactivation credit at 50% if they return within 60 days.
Anika V: flag active and verified they can access reporting as their admin. logs show successful access at 2027-03-10T14:05Z.
Grace H: during workshop we'll ask 3 feedback q's: 1) what prevented the admin from seeing reports? 2) was the UI clear about role scopes? 3) would a sample setup or checklist have helped? paste answers here after call.
CS Ops Bot: [ticket-9910] status updated -> in-progress (Grace H).
Miles D: after we get the feedback I'll convert to a tiny product task: either fix console messaging or adjust default role mapping.
Grace H: workshop done. feedback: 1) their admin role wasn't auto-mapped to 'reports' — confusing, 2) UI didn't show effective permissions, 3) they want a one-click 'verify admin access' step. pasted to ticket-9910.
Omar K: noted. updated ticket with upgrade path and added neutral CSM script for possible downgrade asks.
Grace H: marking account "at-risk: access friction" and setting renewal-check in 10 days. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
